classes.name: AssemblyAssemblyOperation
classes.summary: One assembly operation. An installation step puts `part` into `into` along `direction` (in the receiving part's model frame) until the acceptance holds; the fit, insert or ring comes from the interface limit of the same kind. predecessors name the operations that must come first, closes the parts it encloses, and tool_access the tools that must reach.
